Introduction to the school
The University of Science, VNU-HCM, is a center for undergraduate and postgraduate training, providing highly qualified human resources and experts in basic sciences, interdisciplinary sciences, and cutting-edge science and technology. These professionals possess the creativity and ability to work in a competitive international environment. It is also a place for conducting cutting-edge scientific research, creating outstanding products that meet the growing needs of science and technology development and socio-economic development of the country, in line with global development trends.

Outstanding Alumni
Mr. Nguyen Minh Triet
Former student of the Mathematics Department at the University of Science, Saigon; former President of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam from 2006 to 2011.
Assoc. Prof. Dr. Vu Hai Quan
A former Computer Science student, he is currently the Minister of Science and Technology.
Prof. Dr. Nguyen Thi Thanh Mai
A former student of Chemistry, currently the Director of the Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City.
Mr. Le Trung
A former student of Electronics and Telecommunications, currently the Director of the Infrastructure Development and Management Center at FPT Telecommunications Joint Stock Company.
Assoc. Prof. Dr. Tran Thi Nhu Hoa
A former Materials Science student, one of the 10 young educators to receive the 2022 Golden Globe Award in the field of new materials technology.
Mr. Hoang Van Quoc Chuong
Former student of Biology & Biotechnology, currently Production Director at Ajinomoto.
Ms. Le Van Anh
A former Environmental Science student, currently the Director of the Institute for Regional and Urban Studies.
MSc. Tran Vu
A former student of Environmental Science, currently serving as the Deputy Director of the Innovation Center at VNU-HCM.
Dr. Phan Minh Lien
A former Biology student, the first Vietnamese person to be honored four times on the Anderson Institute's Wall of Fame, a leading cancer institute in the United States.
Dr. Pham Thanh Tuan Anh
A former student of Materials Science, currently serving as Deputy Head of the Advanced Materials Laboratory, Faculty of Science, VNU-HCM.
Professor Nguyen Trong Toan
A former student of the gifted undergraduate program in Mathematics, she is currently a professor at Pennsylvania State University – ranked 17th among public universities in the United States.
PhD Candidate Nguyen Quoc Trung
A former student of Inorganic Chemistry, currently pursuing a PhD at Umeå University (Sweden), she is now focusing her research on geological and inorganic chemistry.
PhD candidate Ngo Huu Thoai
A former student of Materials Science and Technology, currently a postdoctoral researcher at the Laboratory of Solid Surface Analysis, Nanostructures and Quantum Materials, Institute of Physics, Chemnitz University of Technology (Germany).
Mr. Lam Dinh Thang
A former student of Information Technology, currently serving as the Director of the Department of Science and Technology of Ho Chi Minh City.
Mr. Diep Bao Canh
A former student of the Physics - Engineering Physics department, currently the General Director of RedSun Solar Energy Joint Stock Company.
Mr. Duong Minh Toi
Former student of the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, currently the Director of Training at TOIDM Education.
